rawIngredients: duck, cassava leaves, lemongrass, shallots, garlic, red chili, candlenut, turmeric, ginger, galangal, shrimp paste (terasi)

culturalNarrative.en: A revered Balinese ceremonial dish featuring tender duck slow-braised and roasted for hours in traditional bumbu genep spice paste, wrapped tightly in aromatic banana and cassava leaves.
culturalNarrative.ja: 何時間もかけて伝統的なスパイスペースト（ブンブ・グネップ）でじっくりと煮込み、バナナの葉で包んで蒸し焼きにした、バリ島の伝統的な儀式用のアヒル料理です。
culturalNarrative.zh: 一道尊贵的巴厘岛传统节庆鸭肉料理，将鸭肉包裹在芳香的香蕉叶和木薯叶中，与秘制Bumbu Genep香料长时间慢炖慢烤，肉质酥烂入味。
culturalNarrative.fr: Un plat de canard cérémoniel balinais emblématique, mijoté lentement puis rôti pendant des heures dans une pâte d'épices bumbu genep, enveloppé de feuilles de bananier parfumées.

allergenFlags.advisoryNote: Contains traditional fermented shrimp paste (terasi) ground into the base aromatic spice paste.
Contains candlenut (kemiri), an Indonesian tree nut used as a culinary thickening and richness agent.
